subject.title: refactor(gateway): route chat transcript injection through the session accessor

question: Should maintainers land this gateway chat transcript accessor slice now, after the current green exact-head CI and live gateway proof, instead of deferring it into the broader SQLite flip?
rationale: The patch is behavior-preserving and review-clean, but it intentionally rewires session-state and message-delivery hot paths under a protected maintainer label, so automation should not make the land/defer choice.

options.title: Land after maintainer signoff
options.body: Use the current green CI and live gateway proof, then merge if maintainers accept this as the correct standalone prep slice for the SQLite migration.

options.title: Defer into the storage flip
options.body: Keep this PR open or later close it if the broader SQLite flip absorbs the same gateway accessor work cleanly.

options.title: Ask for broader live proof
options.body: Request an additional real webchat/source-reply media proof before merge if maintainers want coverage beyond the current chat.inject and transcript artifact proof.

recommendation.title: Land after maintainer signoff
recommendation.body: Use the current green CI and live gateway proof, then merge if maintainers accept this as the correct standalone prep slice for the SQLite migration.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has the strongest recent history on the accessor migration slices and this PR’s exact gateway/session boundary.
